{{Quote|Zee's at the Imperial spaceport! He's on his way to Mechis Three for a business meeting! He's probably already gone!|A [[Nebula Communications]] security officer, to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:CZ" />}}
'''Docking Bay 27''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located in the [[Mezenti Spaceport]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] participating in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] confronted a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] security expert [[Zee K'lin]] in the docking bay, demanding the codes to [[Eidolon Security]] encryption programs.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Docking Bay 27 appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission.<ref name="TOR:CZ" />
